change.summary: Merchants must ensure relevant products placed on the Union market comply with deforestation and forest degradation rules by the dates set out in Article 38. This regulation applies to operators and traders placing or making available listed commodities on the Union market.

obligations.text: Ensure relevant products placed on the Union market comply with deforestation rules.
obligations.quote: This Regulation lays down rules regarding the placing and making available on the Union market as well as the export from the Union of relevant products, as listed in Annex I, that contain, have been fed with or have been made using relevant commodities

obligations.text: Do not place on the Union market relevant products produced before the date in Article 38(1).
obligations.quote: Except as provided for in Article 37(3), this Regulation does not apply to relevant products listed in Annex I produced before the date indicated in Article 38(1).

reasons: You are established in Germany and ship to multiple EU countries, so you place products on the Union market.
You sell wooden furniture and leather goods, which contain or are made using wood and cattle — both listed as relevant commodities under this regulation.
The regulation binds operators and traders who make available relevant products listed in Annex I, and your product categories fall within the typical scope of those annexes.

todos.text: Check which of your wooden furniture and leather goods fall under the Annex I product list and start gathering geolocation and supplier data for those items
todos.quote: This Regulation lays down rules regarding the placing and making available on the Union market as well as the export from the Union of relevant products, as listed in Annex I, that contain, have been fed with or have been made using relevant commodities

todos.text: Identify the Article 38(1) cutoff date and verify that stock you place on the EU market after 30 December 2026 was not produced before that date
todos.quote: Except as provided for in Article 37(3), this Regulation does not apply to relevant products listed in Annex I produced before the date indicated in Article 38(1).
